front.title: Thoughts and observations on Apple's Surprise and Shine event
front.tldr: John Gruber's rundown of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5 and Apple Watch Series 12 launches, and what the event says about where the company goes next.

front.title: Apple explains how Reference Image proves a photo is real
front.tldr: Apple's security team has published a detailed explanation of Reference Image, the iPhone 18 Pro feature that cryptographically verifies a photo hasn't been altered. Worth reading in full.

front.title: Five takeaways from Paul George and Mike Conley's introductory press conference
front.tldr: The Celtics introduced free-agent signings Paul George and Mike Conley on Tuesday, with early notes on fit, health and how they see their roles alongside Boston's core this season.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini Live audio, two new speech-to-speech models
stories.tldr: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking, speech-to-speech models similar in shape to OpenAI's GPT-Live family. Simon Willison tested them against GPT-6 and shares his notes.

stories.title: Meta lets AI agents handle WhatsApp Business setup
stories.tldr: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers point coding agents like Claude, Cursor and Codex at setup, messaging templates and troubleshooting, cutting the manual configuration work.

stories.title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation with $180m Series D
stories.tldr: Profound, which helps brands track how they appear in AI answers, raised $180 million at a $1.8 billion valuation, just seven months after its last round closed.

stories.title: Ex-TikTok execs built an AI app that teaches you how to pose for photos
stories.tldr: Superpose analyses a selfie or photo and generates four suggested poses using AI, built by a team of former TikTok executives turning their attention to camera apps.

stories.title: SpaceX will try to put Starship in orbit for the first time on 22 September
stories.tldr: Elon Musk's company will attempt its first full orbital Starship flight next week and also try to deploy the first V3 Starlink satellites into its internet constellation.

stories.title: Canon's R8 II camera borrows its styling from a classic SLR
stories.tldr: Canon's new full-frame R8 II leans on retro film-camera design cues, a break from its recent focus on vlogging-first cameras.

stories.title: Microsoft to hold a Windows and Surface event on 7 October
stories.tldr: Satya Nadella and Nvidia's Jensen Huang are among the speakers at Microsoft's October event, which will focus on Windows, Nvidia's RTX Spark and the wider Surface and PC lineup.

stories.title: Wonder scores a $425m partnership with DoorDash as it builds its food empire
stories.tldr: Marc Lore's restaurant and delivery company Wonder struck a $425 million partnership with DoorDash, another step in building out its multi-brand food business.

stories.title: AirPods 5 hands-on: better noise cancellation, lower price
stories.tldr: MacRumors spent a week with the new AirPods 5 and found improved noise cancellation at a lower starting price than the outgoing model.

stories.title: iOS 27 adds natural language event creation to Calendar
stories.tldr: Apple's Calendar app can now create events from plain English descriptions in iOS 27, a small but long-requested feature.

stories.title: M5 Ultra chip's performance boost revealed in first benchmark
stories.tldr: An unverified Geekbench result for Apple's upcoming M5 Ultra chip has surfaced, pointing to a substantial performance jump ahead of the next Mac Studio.

stories.title: Widow's Bay becomes the most decorated freshman comedy in Emmy history
stories.tldr: Apple TV's Widow's Bay won big at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, helping Apple TV land 29 wins overall and top the night.

stories.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil reboot draws raves in first reactions
stories.tldr: Critics called the Zach Cregger-directed Resident Evil reboot 'gloriously gory' and one of the best video game adaptations yet, ahead of its 18 September release.

stories.title: A Talent for Murder review: Helen Mirren is mesmerising as Patricia Highsmith
stories.tldr: Helen Mirren plays crime writer Patricia Highsmith in this flawed but entertaining literary biopic, which premiered at the Toronto Film Festival.

stories.title: Avengers: Endgame re-release could give Marvel its biggest box-office record
stories.tldr: Avengers: Endgame returns to cinemas as Endgame: Encore, with analysts weighing whether the re-release could reclaim the all-time box-office record for Marvel.

stories.title: Elsinore writer on telling the story of actor Ian Charleson
stories.tldr: Screenwriter Stephen Beresford discusses his biopic about Ian Charleson, the gay actor whose career and life are the subject of the new film Elsinore, which premiered at Toronto.

stories.title: Paul George shares injury update at Celtics introductory press conference
stories.tldr: Paul George, who has played just 78 games over his last two seasons in Philadelphia, gave an update on his health as he was introduced by the Celtics.

stories.title: The Al Horford blueprint for unlocking Paul George
stories.tldr: With Jaylen Brown traded to Philadelphia for Paul George, CelticsBlog looks at how Boston can use Al Horford's role as a model for getting the best out of George.

stories.title: How the Patriots plan to cover for A.J. Brown's injury
stories.tldr: With A.J. Brown sidelined, Boston.com identifies five Patriots who need to step up on offence as the team adjusts heading into Week 2.

stories.title: Contract details for Christian Gonzalez's extension with the Patriots
stories.tldr: New England reached a new deal with cornerback Christian Gonzalez, ending one of the summer's lingering storylines before the season began.

stories.title: Russell and Hamilton concede F1 2026 title chances as Antonelli dominates
stories.tldr: Both Mercedes drivers have effectively given up on this year's championship as teammate Kimi Antonelli builds a commanding points lead.

stories.title: McLaren must help Oscar Piastri stop 'thinking' about the 2026 car, says Stella
stories.tldr: Team principal Andrea Stella believes Piastri's deficit to Lando Norris stems from the Australian still consciously adapting to this year's Formula 1 machinery rather than driving on instinct.

stories.title: Audi's F1 junior Freddie Slater signs F2 deal for 2027
stories.tldr: Formula 3 runner-up and Audi junior driver Freddie Slater will move up to Formula 2 with reigning champion team Invicta Racing next season.

stories.title: Jacob deGrom strikes out 8 as Rangers beat Red Sox 4-2
stories.tldr: Red Sox starter Patrick Sandoval struck out his first four batters but allowed four runs in 2 2/3 innings as Boston fell to Texas in a game between playoff contenders.

stories.title: Payton Tolle should start Game 1 for the Red Sox in the playoffs, argues Over the Monster
stories.tldr: With Boston's rotation set for a likely wild card series against the Yankees, the case is made for handing Tolle the ball over Ranger Suarez or Sonny Gray.

finally.title: A homemade computer built from hundreds of 1950s vacuum tubes
finally.tldr: The Tube Computer was built from hundreds of vintage vacuum tubes sourced from Eastern Europe, and apparently has a pleasant, homely smell as a bonus.
